reproduction.capture: nice -n 19 taskset -c 8-15,24-31 ionice -c 3 python3 -B capture.py NEW_PRIVATE_DIRECTORY </dev/null
reproduction.restore: From this packet directory, restore each archive using its restore_command; copy retained JSON/log files back to the same paths under build/capture. Original files are never removed by this tool.

retention_reason: Small independent-text target streams preserve every captured state byte needed to repeat draft analysis; archives are storage only and every member was byte-compared and hashed.
